title: Module 4 — Proposal assembly output
description: Output envelope of 04-proposal-assembly. Records the artifacts produced: the generated Google Doc / PDF, the Gmail message (addressed to the client's own commercial contact, NOT the extracted end customer), whether it was actually delivered, and the Telegram notification.

document_id.description: Google Doc id of the assembled proposal.

draft_id.description: Gmail draft id. Always present — delivery is create-draft then drafts.send.

draft_recipient.description: MUST be the client's commercial contact (client_config.commercial_contact_email) or the RFQ sender, never the extracted end-customer email.

sent.description: True when the draft was actually delivered via drafts.send. False means send_mode was 'draft' and the mail was deliberately parked — a genuine send failure fails the workflow instead of reporting false.

sent_message_id.description: Gmail message id returned by drafts.send. Null when sent is false.

from_alias.description: The verified 'Send mail as' address the message was sent from: demo@cifral.io for trial clients, proposal@cifral.io otherwise.

thread_id.description: Gmail thread the reply was attached to. Null on runs with no originating thread (chat trigger, standalone module calls), where a new conversation is started instead.

sections_rendered.description: Optional. Scope-item keys whose template blocks were kept in the final document (excluded blocks were deleted).
